input.meaning: hardcoded assumption a human typed — blue text on yellow fill

formula.meaning: calculation — default ink, no special color

link.meaning: pulled from another sheet — green text. Authoritative green is #00B050 (Macabacus link standard, Excel FF00B050 + web); the model's generic #008000 is superseded.

error.meaning: error / failed check ONLY — red text

rules: Zero displays as an en-dash (–), never 0.0.
Negatives in parentheses, positives bare; the _( and _) spacers reserve paren width so decimals align.
Currency symbol at most on the top row of a column; scale stated once in the header (e.g. "$'s in '000s").
Margins are grey + italic.  Totals are bold.
Color encodes provenance: blue = input, green = cross-sheet link, red = error/check, default ink = formula.
Toggles force a real 1/0: positive shows the on-word, zero the off-word, anything else ERROR.
